newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita to spend 120 bln yen on LCDs--paper.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita to spend 120 bln yen on LCDs--paper.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd will invest a total of 120 billion yen before 2000 in expanding production of liquid crystal displays, business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday.
It plans to invest mainly in production facilities for thin film transistors (TFTs), currently the most advanced type of liquid crystal display, the paper said.
The company aims to more than double its annual sales of the product, used for notebook-sized personal computers and other LCD screens, to 150 billion yen in 2000.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
